title: The I3322 quantum value is attained spatially but not in finite dimension
description: Version 4.1.0: revised proof and verification release. Three theorems about the I3322 Bell functional start from an exactly certified window for its quantum value S and tensor/commuting value equality. No finite-dimensional strategy attains S (arbitrary finite local dimensions, mixed states and binary POVMs), while a spatial strategy on l2(Z) tensor l2(Z) does. Consequently C_q(3,3;2,2) is not closed and differs from C_qs in the smallest scenario by input count among binary-output bipartite scenarios where nonclosure is known; no minimality is claimed over larger output alphabets. The dimension complexity is D(eps) = Theta(log(1/eps)); constructively D(eps) <= 23.9010650 log(1/eps) for all sufficiently small eps, with no explicit threshold supplied. The replacement finite weighted-flow lower proof has existential constants and removes an unjustified component-identification step; foundational and upper-bound estimates and spatial-amplitude exposition were also corrected. Lean 4 checks 37 selected declarations using standard axioms only; the complete analytic proof is not formalized. The exact value beyond the certified window is not identified here. Pauwels (arXiv:2608.29734v1, Theorem 1) proves equality of the finite Pal-Vertesi-family and finite quantum suprema; this does not identify the limit of any prescribed numerical parameter sequence. Pauwels proves finite nonattainment; Coladangelo (arXiv:2609.06038v1) independently proves finite nonattainment and spatial attainment. Original certificates, provenance and correction history are preserved, including the earlier public decertification. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21782008 identifies the version family; historical v4.0.0 remains DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22099128 and does not contain this revision.
